items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: it was called Jimmy Bach and his Eight Cylinders in Music

ctx.x: And I played with all these — we had two ladies also, saxophonists, and it was called Jimmy Bach and his Eight Cylinders in Music. And that was a big deal. And they went on to Purdue, engineering. And while they were up there a couple of years I think they had a New Years Eve gig and they needed another trumpet player, a ride man, and they said well you ought to get Pete Candoli, he does all the things with Cylinders. So they said well could you get him? One of those. So one of the guys came back, drove back from…
